intent: Implement TelemetryProperties exactly as tabled. Immutable record bound from the telemetry.* prefix of application.yml via @ConfigurationProperties (kebab-case keys map to the camelCase components). Carries the externalized operational values: reorder window seconds, buffer capacity, and Sensor Metric Boundaries (heart rate, power, cadence min/max, swim pace exclusive lower bound). No defaults or fallback literals in code; values come only from the config unit.

methods.signature: TelemetryProperties(long reorderWindowSeconds, int bufferCapacity, double heartRateMin, double heartRateMax, double powerMin, double powerMax, double cadenceMin, double cadenceMax, double swimPaceMinExclusive)
